description: Backend notification service and API: create notification-service.js with core notifyOwner() function and abnormal activity detectors (large sales, large stock movements, security events), create routes-notifications.js with owner notification endpoints (list, read, mark-all-read, stats), integrate notification triggers into routes-sales.js (refunds, abnormal sales), routes-stock.js (abnormal adjustments), routes-core.js (auth events: failed logins, password changes, new user, role changes, deactivations), routes-owner.js (pharmacy/staff changes).
steps: Create worker/src/notification-service.js: export async function notifyOwner(db, ownerId, { pharmacyId, type, category, title, message, metadata, requiresAction }) that inserts into owner_notifications. Helper detectAbnormalSale(db, pharmacy, sale) checks if total > pharmacy.expiry_warn_days * 100 (heuristic: large sale). Helper detectAbnormalStock(db, pharmacy, adjustment) checks if Math.abs(adjustment.qty_change) > 500. Helper detectSecurityIssue(db, user, action, detail) always returns true for failed logins, password changes, new user, role changes, deactivations. Helper detectCriticalAlert(db, pharmacy, event) for system-wide critical events.

Create worker/src/routes-notifications.js: GET /api/owner/notifications with pagination (page, limit 50 max), filters (unread, category, pharmacy_id, type), returns notifications for c.get('user').id where user.is_system_owner. PUT /api/owner/notifications/:id/read marks single notification as read. PUT /api/owner/notifications/mark-all-read marks all unread for owner as read. GET /api/owner/notifications/stats returns { total, unread, critical, by_category: {...} }. All routes use need('owner') middleware and verify ownership (notification.owner_user_id === user.id).

Update worker/src/routes-sales.js: In POST /sales after successful sale creation, call detectAbnormalSale and notifyOwner if true. In POST /sales/:id/void after refund/void, always call notifyOwner with type='warning', category='sales', title='Sale Refunded/Voided', message with sale_no and reason. Use pharmacy.owner_user_id from pharmacy record.

Update worker/src/routes-stock.js: In POST /adjustments after adjustment, call detectAbnormalStock and notifyOwner if true with type='warning', category='stock', title='Large Stock Adjustment', message with drug name, quantity, reason. Use pharmacy.owner_user_id.

Update worker/src/routes-core.js: In POST /auth/login after failed login (inside the fail block after audit log), check if user exists and has pharmacy, then notify owner with type='security', category='auth', title='Failed Login Attempt'. In POST /auth/change-password after success, notify owner. In POST /users (new user) after creation, notify owner. In PUT /users/:id when role changes or active changes to 0, notify owner.

Update worker/src/routes-owner.js if pharmacy/staff management changes: In POST /pharmacies after creation, notify owner with category='system'. In PUT /pharmacies/:id when active changes, notify. In POST /staff and PUT /staff/:id when role changes or active changes, notify with category='staff'.
Update worker/src/index.js: Add 'import notificationRoutes from './routes-notifications.js';' and 'app.route('/api/owner', notificationRoutes);' after existing owner routes registration.
acceptance_criteria: notification-service.js exports notifyOwner and all detector functions
routes-notifications.js implements all 4 endpoints with proper auth and ownership checks
Sales route triggers notifications on refunds/voids and abnormal sales
Stock route triggers notifications on abnormal adjustments
Core route triggers notifications on auth events (failed login, password change, new user, role change, deactivation)
Owner route triggers notifications on pharmacy/staff changes
All notifications correctly identify owner_user_id from pharmacy.owner_user_id
Notifications include proper type, category, title, message, and metadata JSON
verification: Start dev server: npm run dev:api
Run smoke tests: npm run test:api (existing tests should pass)
Manual test: Create a sale with large total, verify notification created via GET /api/owner/notifications
Manual test: Void a sale, verify notification appears
Manual test: Create stock adjustment > 500 units, verify notification
Manual test: Attempt failed login, verify security notification
Manual test: Change user password, verify notification
Manual test: Create new user, verify notification
Manual test: Change user role or deactivate, verify notification
Manual test: GET /api/owner/notifications/stats returns correct counts
Manual test: PUT /api/owner/notifications/:id/read marks notification as read
Verify no errors in Worker logs during notification creation
findings: Successfully implemented backend notification service and API integration. Created notification-service.js with notifyOwner() function and all detector helpers (detectAbnormalSale, detectAbnormalStock, detectSecurityIssue, detectCriticalAlert). Created routes-notifications.js with 4 endpoints: GET /api/owner/notifications (with pagination and filters), PUT /api/owner/notifications/:id/read, PUT /api/owner/notifications/mark-all-read, GET /api/owner/notifications/stats. Integrated notification triggers into routes-sales.js (abnormal sales, refunds/voids), routes-stock.js (abnormal adjustments), routes-core.js (failed logins, password changes, new users, role changes, deactivations), and routes-owner.js (pharmacy/staff changes). All notifications properly identify owner_user_id from pharmacy.owner_user_id. Fixed duplicate import statements in routes-core.js and index.js. Wrangler dry-run deployment succeeds with no errors. All acceptance criteria met.
